author: MiniWarGaming
description:
Get 'em here:  forge.MiniWarGaming.com

Take a trip through memory lane with a look at classic Warhammer 40000 editions.

We are digging through a massive collection of old Warhammer books, ranging from 3rd edition all the way up to the current 10th edition. Whether you are a fan of lore or just love seeing how the game evolved, this is a great look back at the history of the hobby.

We also touch on some classic Necromunda and Aeronautica Imperialis titles for those who enjoy the specialist games.

Check out the collection here: https://forge.miniwargaming.com
title: Look At Some Old Books With Me
